notes: Account background: mid-market B2B SaaS (analytics platform) building an in-app semantic layer for customer queries and internal search.
Initial ask: embeddings + semantic search for knowledge base + support routing. Want predictable latency and lower cost than current pilot (managed vector DB + ad-hoc infra).

POC approach: start on Hosted API for 2-week rapid validation, then move to Dedicated (reserved pool) for throughput/cost testing. POC will include: 100k test vectors, KNN search top-10 latency profile, and 72-hour ingest stress run.
Performance targets (from CTO): 'sub-120ms median for top-10 on p95 load; sustain 250-300 QPS for API queries during peak windows' — Maya Singh quote from 11/21 call.
Batch requirements: nightly bulk upserts (5M docs/month), incremental micro-batches during business hours. Interested in Redwood's suggested batching + caching profile to reduce token costs.
Vector DB integrations: currently evaluating connectors to Pinecone and Milvus; want to validate Redwood's ingestion patterns and compatibility (embedding dimension 1536, float16/quantized profiles).
Security/compliance: must pass SOC2-like checklist, require SSO/SAML, KMS for key management, audit logs for all inference calls, and ability to restrict data residency to NA.
Cost sensitivity: mid-market procurement — will consider 12-month commit for Dedicated if unit economics show >30% cost improvement over hosted pilot at target QPS.
Stakeholders: product (Ethan), platform/infra (Jordan), security (Maya). AE is championing quick wins to unblock procurement.
Quotes/verbals: 'We need to see sustained cost reduction before signing on Dedicated — show us real numbers with our corpus' (Ethan, 11/28).
Docs shared: test corpus (anonymized tickets + KB), traffic profile spreadsheet, internal latency SLO doc. Asked Redwood for sample pricing scenarios and dedicated capacity sizing.
Preferred timeline: 2-week hosted POC starting 2024-12-10, then 4-week dedicated throughput validation in Jan 2025 if POC meets targets.
Notes on risk: potential blocker is their internal procurement capex window (budget locked until Feb) — may force mid-contract cadence.
AE asks: send Dedicated pricing tiers + can we provide a 30-day refundable Dedicated trial? SE to propose instance types and expected token/unit costs.
Internal Redwood actions: SE (Priya) to run sizing, prepare a runbook for ingest and sample curl/SDK scripts, provide perf baseline from similar workloads.
Customer requested artifacts: sample warmup scripts, prefix cache recommendation, and a one-page security FAQ aligned with their SOC2 controls.
